complexity_analysis.reasoning: Medium-sized React SPA (~13k LOC, 73 modules) with no local DB; 4 migration checkpoints cover foundation setup, auth and admin UI, feature suites (CodeFlo/DocFlo/Run), and production hardening.

checkpoints.title: Foundation and Infrastructure
checkpoints.description: Bootstrap Next.js 15 project, migrate build configuration, set up TypeScript and Tailwind 4, create engine API Route Handlers proxy, and migrate shared type definitions.

tasks.title: Bootstrap Next.js 15 App Router project
tasks.description: Create a new Next.js 15 project using the App Router with TypeScript enabled. Configure next.config.js with output mode, basePath, and redirects.
acceptance_criteria: next build completes without errors
next dev starts and serves the root route
TypeScript compilation succeeds with strict mode
No VITE_* environment variables present

tasks.title: Migrate TypeScript configuration
tasks.description: Port tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.node.json strict settings into Next.js tsconfig.json. Enable noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
acceptance_criteria: tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
noUncheckedIndexedAccess is enabled
Path aliases resolve correctly in Next.js

tasks.title: Migrate Tailwind CSS 3 to Tailwind CSS 4 (CSS-first config)
tasks.description: Upgrade tailwindcss to v4. Replace tailwind.config.js with CSS-first configuration using @theme directive.
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind 4 installed and compiles without errors
Custom theme tokens available as CSS custom properties
All Tailwind utility classes preserved
No tailwind.config.js required at runtime

tasks.title: Migrate shared type definitions
tasks.description: Copy src/types/engine.ts and src/types/codeRepos.ts to the Next.js project. Replace Vite-specific imports.
acceptance_criteria: All 18 entity interfaces from source/src/types/engine.ts present
All code repo types present
No vite-env.d.ts references
tsc compiles without errors

tasks.title: Migrate utility libraries (lib/)
tasks.description: Port all src/lib/*.ts utility modules. Remove Vite-specific imports.
acceptance_criteria: All utility functions compile without errors
No import.meta.env references remain
cn() helper functions correctly with Tailwind 4 class names

tasks.title: Create engine API Route Handlers (server-side proxy)
tasks.description: Create Next.js Route Handlers that proxy all requests to ENGINE_URL server-side. Implement generic REST proxy and SSE streaming proxy. Fixes SEC-C-001.
acceptance_criteria: ENGINE_URL set only in server environment
All engineClient.ts functions call /api/engine/...
SSE streaming endpoints return proper text/event-stream response
next build succeeds with no environment variable warnings

tasks.title: Configure environment variables and .env files
tasks.description: Replace all VITE_* environment variables with Next.js conventions. Audit codebase for remaining import.meta.env references.
acceptance_criteria: Zero import.meta.env references in new codebase
ENGINE_URL is NOT prefixed with NEXT_PUBLIC_
next build does not embed ENGINE_URL in browser bundle

tasks.title: Set up QueryClient and global providers
tasks.description: Create React Query provider as Client Component. Create root app/layout.tsx wrapping app in all providers.
acceptance_criteria: Root layout compiles as a Server Component
QueryProvider is a 'use client' Client Component
useQuery hooks are functional
next dev starts without React context errors

checkpoints.title: Auth, Admin, and Core UI
checkpoints.description: Migrate authentication flows, all admin pages, layout shell components, and shared UI primitives. Admin key moves to HTTP-only cookie (fixes SEC-H-001).

tasks.title: Migrate authentication hook and context
tasks.description: Port useAuth.tsx. Replace sessionStorage admin key with HTTP-only cookie via Route Handler. Closes SEC-H-001.
acceptance_criteria: SSO login redirect works
Admin key stored in HttpOnly cookie, not sessionStorage
Sign-out clears server-side cookie
SEC-H-001 remediation verified

tasks.title: Migrate LoginPage
tasks.description: Port LoginPage.tsx to app/login/page.tsx. Add client-side rate limiting (SEC-M-003) and key format validation (SEC-M-001).
acceptance_criteria: All three login modes functional
Password submit disabled for 2 seconds after failure
Admin key input shows format validation warning
Redirect to dashboard on successful login

tasks.title: Migrate layout shell components (AppLayout, Sidebar, Topbar)
tasks.description: Port layout components. Replace React Router Link with Next.js Link. Add middleware for auth guard.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated route group renders AppLayout
Sidebar navigation links work with Next.js Link
Unauthenticated users redirected to /login
Admin-only routes redirect non-admin users

tasks.title: Migrate shared UI primitive components
tasks.description: Port all components/ui/ primitives. Remove React Router and Vite-specific imports.
acceptance_criteria: All 14 UI primitive components compile
No React Router imports in UI primitives
Tailwind 4 classes apply correctly

tasks.title: Migrate theme and keyboard shortcut hooks
tasks.description: Port useTheme, useSidebarCollapse, useKeyboardShortcuts, useHighlightTheme, and ShortcutsContext. Use SSR-compatible theme toggle.
acceptance_criteria: Dark/light theme toggle works without hydration flash
Keyboard shortcuts functional in client
Sidebar collapse state persists

tasks.title: Migrate DashboardPage
tasks.description: Port DashboardPage.tsx to app/(authenticated)/dashboard/page.tsx as RSC with prefetched data.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard renders suite cards with prefetched data
Navigation to suite pages works
Your apps grid renders correctly

tasks.title: Migrate admin pages: UsersPage and UserDetailPage
tasks.description: Port UsersPage.tsx and UserDetailPage.tsx. Increase password minimum to 12 chars (SEC-L-003). Replace useParams with Next.js params.
acceptance_criteria: User list renders with pagination
Inline role assignment works
Password minimum length 12 chars
useParams replaced with Next.js params prop

tasks.title: Migrate admin pages: RolesPage, AuditLogPage, CreditsPage
tasks.description: Port RolesPage.tsx, AuditLogPage.tsx, CreditsPage.tsx and related component folders.
acceptance_criteria: All three admin pages render with real data
Role catalog display matches source
Audit log pagination works
Spend cap and topup flow functional

tasks.title: Migrate MyProfilePage
tasks.description: Port MyProfilePage.tsx to app/(authenticated)/profile/page.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: Profile page renders user info from /v1/me endpoint
Spend cap display matches source
Accessible to non-admin users

checkpoints.title: Feature Suites: Run Minds and CodeFlo+
checkpoints.description: Migrate RunPage (1,549 lines, SSE streaming) and CodeFlo+ (repo browser, kanban, review). SSE streaming through Route Handler proxy is highest-risk work.

tasks.title: Implement and test SSE streaming Route Handler
tasks.description: Implement and verify SSE proxy Route Handler before migrating RunPage. Create a test harness page to validate streaming works end-to-end.
acceptance_criteria: SSE test page shows streaming tokens progressively
Route Handler sets Content-Type: text/event-stream with no-cache
First token appears within 2 seconds
Stream terminates cleanly on [DONE] event
No buffering of tokens

tasks.title: Migrate RunPage — Execute and Chat modes
tasks.description: Port RunPage.tsx (1,549 lines) to app/(authenticated)/run/[mindId]/page.tsx. Split into sub-components. Fix SEC-H-002: replace localStorage with sessionStorage for Mind Share Key.
acceptance_criteria: Execute mode: form submits and SSE stream renders tokens progressively
Chat mode: message history renders correctly
Session history sidebar works
Mind Share Key stored in sessionStorage only (SEC-H-002 fixed)
No hydration errors

tasks.title: Migrate CodeReposPage and CodeRepoViewerPage
tasks.description: Port CodeReposPage.tsx and CodeRepoViewerPage.tsx. Preserve file tree navigation, pagination, walk limits, and syntax highlighting.
acceptance_criteria: Code repo list renders with real data
File tree navigation works with pagination
Syntax highlighting via highlight.js renders
Walk limits preserved
Breadcrumb navigation functional

tasks.title: Migrate CodeRepoKanbanPage and CodeRepoReviewPage
tasks.description: Port CodeRepoKanbanPage.tsx and CodeRepoReviewPage.tsx. Migrate codeRepoChat.ts integration.
acceptance_criteria: Kanban board renders code repo tasks
Review page shows diff/review interface
Code repo chat integration functional
Pages compile without errors

checkpoints.title: DocFlo+, Polish, Security Hardening, and Testing
checkpoints.description: Migrate DocFlo+ pages, implement CSP headers and remaining security fixes, add comprehensive test suite (Vitest + Playwright), and perform final production hardening.

tasks.title: Migrate DocFlo pages
tasks.description: Port DocFloAgentsPage.tsx, DocFloAgentChatPage.tsx, and DocFloCorpusPage.tsx. Verify SSE streaming works for DocFlo agent responses.
acceptance_criteria: DocFlo agent list renders
Agent chat works with streaming response
Corpus page renders document list
Navigation between DocFlo sections works

tasks.title: Implement Content Security Policy headers
tasks.description: Configure CSP headers in next.config.js. Add X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy. Closes SEC-H-003 and SEC-L-002.
acceptance_criteria: next dev serves CSP header on all pages
No CSP violations on dashboard and run pages
X-Frame-Options: DENY present
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff present

tasks.title: Implement key format validation and rate limiting
tasks.description: Add client-side key format validation and rate limiting. Closes SEC-M-001 and SEC-M-003.
acceptance_criteria: Admin key input shows 'Invalid key format' warning for invalid strings
Password submit disabled for 2 seconds after failure
Valid keys not blocked
SEC-M-001 and SEC-M-003 documented as remediated

tasks.title: Add SSE integrity logging and TLS documentation
tasks.description: Add production-safe telemetry hook for SSE parse failures. Add infrastructure deployment documentation. Addresses SEC-M-002.
acceptance_criteria: SSE parse failures produce structured log event without payload data
Deployment README documents TLS requirement and CORS config

tasks.title: Audit and pin lucide-react dependency
tasks.description: Run npm audit, verify lucide-react integrity, pin to exact stable version. Addresses SEC-L-001.
acceptance_criteria: npm audit returns zero high/critical vulnerabilities
lucide-react pinned to exact version
All icon imports work after version pin

tasks.title: Add unit and component tests with Vitest
tasks.description: Set up Vitest with React Testing Library. Write unit tests for engineClient.ts, auth-validation.ts, credit-errors.ts, utils.ts. Write component tests for Button, Input, LoginPage. Target >= 70% branch coverage.
acceptance_criteria: vitest run completes with zero failures
>= 70% branch coverage on engineClient.ts
>= 70% branch coverage on auth-validation.ts
LoginPage tests cover all three login modes and rate limiting

tasks.title: Add end-to-end tests with Playwright
tasks.description: Set up Playwright. Write E2E tests for: SSO login, password login, execute a Mind with streaming, create user as admin, assign role.
acceptance_criteria: playwright test runs all specs with zero failures
Login E2E covers SSO and password flow
Run Mind E2E verifies streaming token appears
Admin user create E2E functional

tasks.title: Lighthouse CI performance audit
tasks.description: Run Lighthouse CI against built Next.js app. Target: performance >= 85, accessibility >= 90.
acceptance_criteria: Lighthouse performance score >= 85 on dashboard and run pages
Lighthouse accessibility score >= 90
No critical accessibility violations
Results documented

tasks.title: Final migration cutover and deployment validation
tasks.description: Merge migration/nextjs branch. Update CI/CD to use next build. Update Docker config to next start. Validate staging. Remove legacy Vite configuration files.
acceptance_criteria: next build succeeds in CI with no warnings
Deployed staging app passes all Playwright E2E tests
No VITE_* variables in deployment config
All 12 security findings documented as remediated or accepted
Legacy vite.config.ts removed
